title: OneSteel Limited - acquisition of Fagersta Steels Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decided to not oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: OneSteel acquired Fagersta Steels Pty Ltd - a distributor of stainless steel products
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC did not consider the acquisition was likely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market due to the presence of several other significantly sized stainless steel distributors.
